name: LongCat-Image-Edit
description:
Here is how to read the LongCat-Image-Edit config.json. The architecture class is unknown, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Image-Edit/blob/main/config.json.
